title: Tighten Git identity guards
summary: Replace permissive project-domain Git identity checks with exact approved project identities, validate the active local author and committer before commits and pushes, and scan pushed refs instead of only the current upstream.
expectedFailureModes: A commit uses a personal alias with a project-domain email and passes the old domain-only policy.
A local checkout creates a bad commit before the pre-push guard has a chance to reject it.
A branch push bypasses the guard because the hook scans HEAD and upstream instead of the actual pushed object.
A legitimate platform bot or project role is rejected by an over-narrow policy.
nextAction: Continue with the next autonomous backlog item.
